title: Pure Scrap
summary: Scrap cards only, with generic staples. Scrap monsters destroy each other by card effect to trigger searches, GY recoveries, and Deck summons from Scrap Factory and Scrap Wyvern.

summary.title: Starters
points: Scrap Raptor destroys a monster you control (including itself) to grant an extra Normal Summon of a Scrap monster, then searches Scrap Factory or a non-Tuner Scrap monster (Scrap Chimera or Scrap Recycler) when destroyed by a Scrap effect.
Scrapyard adds any Scrap Tuner (Scrap Raptor, Scrap Orthros, Scrap Beast, or Scrap Goblin) from the Deck to the hand.
Scrap Chimera revives a Scrap Tuner from your GY when Normal Summoned.
Scrap Recycler sends a Machine monster (such as Scrap Mind Reader) from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Scrap Raptor or Scrapyard
steps: Normal Summon Scrap Raptor, use its effect to destroy itself for an extra Scrap Normal Summon, and use Raptor's GY trigger to search Scrap Chimera (or Scrap Factory if you already have Chimera).
Use your extra Normal Summon on Scrap Chimera to revive Scrap Raptor, then Link Summon Scrap Wyvern.

Use Scrap Wyvern's first effect to revive Scrap Raptor and destroy it, which triggers Scrap Wyvern's second effect (plus Scrap Factory if face-up) to Special Summon Scrap Golem from the Deck and destroy an opposing card, then use Scrap Golem to revive Scrap Raptor or Goblin for Synchro plays.

summary.title: Self-Destruction Chain Loop
summary.text: Whenever a face-up Scrap monster is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY, Scrap Factory and Scrap Wyvern each Special Summon a Scrap monster directly from the Deck. Meanwhile, Scrap Goblin, Scrap Beast, and Scrap Orthros recover a Scrap monster (such as Scrap Chimera) from the GY to the hand whenever a Scrap card destroys them, and Scrap Searcher revives itself from the GY whenever another Scrap monster you control is destroyed.

summary.title: Extra Deck Bosses
points: Scrap Wyvern (Link-2) revives a Scrap monster and destroys a Scrap to Special Summon any Scrap monster from the Deck (such as Level 5 Scrap Golem) and destroy 1 card on the field without targeting.

Scrap Dragon (Level 8) destroys 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls once per turn, while Scrap Twin Dragon (Level 9) destroys 1 card you control to return 2 cards the opponent controls to the hand.

Atomic Scrap Dragon (Level 10) destroys 1 card you control to shuffle up to 3 cards from the opponent's GY into the Deck, and all three Dragon Synchros revive a non-Synchro Scrap when destroyed by the opponent.

summary.title: Spells
points: Scrap Factory boosts all Scrap monsters by 200 ATK/DEF and summons a Scrap from the Deck once per turn when a face-up Scrap monster is destroyed by card effect.
Scrapstorm sends a Scrap monster from the Deck to the GY, draws 1 card, and destroys a face-up Scrap monster you control as a Quick-Play Spell.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Dinosaur and Orcust hybrids are omitted in this pure build. Scrap Synchron and Scrap Warrior are Junk Warrior support that do not trigger Scrap effects, and the 2025 Trap Scrap Garage revives DARK Machines, which this list does not run.

main: Tuner starter: destroys your monster for an extra Scrap Normal Summon; searches Factory or a non-Tuner.
Normal Summoned: revives a Scrap Tuner from the GY.
Tuner: destroyed by a Scrap card, returns a Scrap from the GY to the hand.
Tuner: summons itself next to a Scrap and destroys one; recovers a Scrap when destroyed.
Sends a Machine from the Deck to the GY when summoned; recycles them for a draw.
Revives a Level 4 or lower Scrap every turn.
Tuner: destroyed by a Scrap card, returns a Scrap from the GY to the hand.
Revives itself when another Scrap is destroyed.
Tuner the Recycler sends; revives itself by destroying a Scrap in Main Phase 2.
Field Spell: summons a Scrap from the Deck when one is destroyed by an effect.
Quick-Play: mills a Scrap, draws, then destroys your Scrap to trigger it.
